description: Source code for custom marshaler and unmarshaler logic in the jsoniter package, handling encoding and decoding of JSON with support for interfaces like json.Marshaler, json.Unmarshaler, encoding.TextMarshaler, and encoding.TextUnmarshaler.

methods.name: createDecoderOfMarshaler
methods.description: Creates a decoder for types implementing json.Unmarshaler or encoding.TextUnmarshaler.

methods.name: createEncoderOfMarshaler
methods.description: Creates an encoder for types implementing json.Marshaler or encoding.TextMarshaler, with special handling for pointers and context.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a value implementing json.Marshaler or encoding.TextMarshaler into a stream.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the value is empty based on custom logic.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into a value implementing json.Unmarshaler or encoding.TextUnmarshaler.
